title: crassula × pulverulenta
intro: Crassula × pulverulenta, commonly known as the Jade Plant or String of Pearls, is a popular, low-maintenance succulent plant that is a hybrid of the species Crassula ovata and Crassula multicava. It is valued for its air-purifying properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments. The health benefits of this plant include reducing stress and anxiety, promoting better sleep, and aiding in wound healing, which can be attributed to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents present in Crassula × pulverulenta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
